name: eMACS J2116.0-0225 (Hubble)

story: Hubble took quick snapshots of extreme, X-ray-bright galaxy clusters like this one, hunting for new gravitational lenses that magnify the distant universe.

claims.text: EMACSJ2116.0-0225 is a target of Hubble program 16670, a snapshot survey of extreme galaxy clusters
